frontend: mGBA 0.10.5 (the macOS app, mGBA.app), isolated config (XDG_CONFIG_HOME)
input: none in the app: it was started with -t STATE and left running ~25 s, then sent SIGTERM. The game's own save routine ran inside the app and the app wrote the file.
started_from: save state of the libretro mgba core (0.11-212-7a12d6d) under tools/retro-run, taken 2 frames after script line 21 (the press that starts the game's save), with battery RAM dumped at the same moment and placed beside the ROM as the app's .sav. Its version word was lowered from 0x0100000B (0.11) to 0x01000007, the newest mGBA 0.10.5 accepts; it loaded with only a BIOS-checksum warning.

layout.save_dir: beside the ROM (the app default: savegamePath unset)
layout.name: <ROM file name without extension>.sav
layout.clock: appended to the .sav, no sidecar: GBA 16 bytes (7 BCD time bytes YY MM DD WD hh mm ss, control, u64 lastLatch); GB MBC3 48 bytes (the VBA-M layout libretro mgba writes as .rtc)
layout.written: while the game runs (the .sav is a mapped file), not only on exit

note: proof.png is the libretro mgba core booting with this file as its .srm (screen capture of the app is not permitted here): the game lists the save. 131088 bytes = 128 KiB flash + 16-byte RTC footer (26 11 04 03 00 08 26 40 + 8 zero bytes: 2026-11-04, Wednesday, 00:08:26, 24-hour mode). libretro mgba writes exactly 131072 and no clock at all. Flash differs from the libretro entry only in the play-dependent sectors 15-19.
